mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, mn.* from Completion_Acceptance_Section mn left join Sec_Info sec on mn.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id where mn.Ca_Id = #{caId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pricing_Method as conPricingMethod, con.Con_Other_Valuation as conOtherValuation, mn.* from Completion_Acceptance_Contract mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id where mn.Ca_Id = #{caId}
select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, mn.* from Completion_Acceptance_Company mn left join SYS_Company c1 on C1.C_Id = mn.C_Id where mn.Ca_Id = #{caId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, c1.C_Name as caContractorName, c2.C_Name as caSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as caApplicantName, c1.C_Abbreviation as caContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as caSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as caApplicantAbbName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Completion_Acceptance mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ca_Contractor_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ca_Supervisor_Id = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ca_Applicant = c3.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Ca_Id where mn.Ca_Id = #{caId}

sql.if: and mn.Ca_Id in (select cas.Ca_Id from Completion_Acceptance_Section cas left join Sec_Info si on si.Sec_Id=cas.Sec_Id where INSTR(si.Sec_Name,#{params.secGroupName}))
